title: Arrival
subtitle: Welcome to Java Island

story.intro:
You wake on wet sand.
Salt stings your eyes. Waves crash rhythmically.

Strange geometric symbols cover the rocks around you:
   { }  [ ]  ( )  ;

A distant mountain pierces the clouds.
Fog lifts, revealing dense jungle ahead.

An ancient stone tablet materializes:

   📜 ISLAND SURVIVAL GUIDE 📜

   1. RUN THE GAME
      Run: mvn exec:java
      Or: Open App.java in your IDE and run it

   2. THE GAME HAS THREE PHASES
      Phase 1: Quest intro (shows automatically)
      Phase 2: Your code (you write this!)
      Phase 3: Validation & rewards (type 'done')

   3. CURRENCY SYSTEM
      🫘 Beans: Currency for trading
      ⭐ XP: Measure of knowledge

   4. SACRED RULES
      App.java → PROTECTED. The framework controls this.
      Your classes → YOURS. Shape your identity here!
story.success:
The stone glows briefly.
You understand the rules of this island.
Your journey begins...

objectives: Understand the game flow: intro → code → done
Learn the commands: done, hint, status, exit
